children: OpenAI said its models helped push the Jalapeno chip from concept to tape-out in just nine months. Broadcom
, the custom AI-chip and infrastructure-software powerhouse that implemented the design, slid approximately 2.0% to $361.125 Wednesday.

Jalapeno targets large-language-model inference and marks the starting point for a multigeneration computing platform. The timing matters. Broadcom's latest quarterly results showed AI-semiconductor revenue rocketing 221% to $16.7 billion, with management projecting $21.7 billion next quarter.

AI-assisted design could compress chip-development timelines and unlock more custom-silicon projects for Broadcom. The chart adds a valuation twist: the $361.125 share price sits 9.68% below the $399.81 GF Value estimate. Customers may control more of the architecture, but Broadcom can still collect attractive economics from implementation, networking and productionthe critical layers that turn a chip blueprint into working AI infrastructure.

title: Broadcom Slides Over 2% While OpenAI Touts a Nine-Month AI Chip Sprint
